 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ARUN KUMAR JHA  ORAL ORDER 3 10-01-2025 Present learned counsel for the petitioners and learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 as well as learned A.P.P. for the State.
02.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioner no.1 is the husband of complainant/opposite party no.2 and the present case has been filed under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
Learned counsel further submits that both the parties are ready to explore the possibility of settlement, for which they submit that the matter may be Patna High Court CR.

MISC. 
No.76280 of 2024(3) dt.10-01-2025 referred to the Patna High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre.

sentences.text:
04. Let the petitioner no.1 and opposite party no. 2 appear before the Mediation Centre on 16.01.2025 at 11:00 A.M. along with the copy of the order and other relevant documents.
05.
It is expected that the learned Mediator will try to resolve the dispute within one month from the date of first appearance of the parties.

06. List this matter on 28.02.2025 along with the report of the learned Mediator.
07.
In the meantime, interim order dated 25.10.2024 shall continue.
